description: This file defines a utility class LazyTry for managing lazy initialization with custom failure handling and locking behavior, along with its companion object for instantiation. It is part of the org.apache.spark.util package.

classes.name: LazyTry
classes.description: A wrapper class for lazy initialization that stores exceptions and avoids locking issues.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the initialized value or re-throws stored exception with current stacktrace.
